newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wah Tak Fung share offer 10.6 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Wah Tak Fung share offer 10.6 times subscribed.

text.p: Property developer Wah Tak Fung Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its offer of 138 millon shares at HK$1.88 each was 10.6 times subscribed.
The new issue, which drew a total demand of 1.32 billion shares, was sponsored by Crosby Capital Markets (Asia) Ltd and Amsteel Corporate Finance (Hong Kong) Ltd.
Proceeds would be channelled into further acquisition of suitable land, properties and interests for development or investment, a company statement said.
Trading of the shares on the Hong Kong bourse begins on September 30, 1997.
